subject: pallid bat
title: This Bat Hunts North America's Most Venomous Scorpion, Stings and All

scenes.text: This bat hunts a scorpion whose sting can kill people.
The Arizona bark scorpion is the most venomous in North America. Its sting brings extreme pain.
The pallid bat listens for footsteps on the desert floor, lands beside it, and grabs it.
High-speed video showed the bats being stung, some of them several times. None of them reacted.
So scientists injected the venom directly. Mice convulsed. Eleven of thirteen bats showed no change at all.
The bat's pain nerves seem to be built differently. Researchers hope the trick leads to new painkillers.

description:
The pallid bat hunts the Arizona bark scorpion, the most venomous scorpion in North America, and takes its stings without reacting.
In a 2017 study from the University of California, Riverside, high-speed video showed bats being stung while catching scorpions, with no visible effect. Injected with venom, 11 of 13 bats showed no change in behaviour, while mice convulsed. The bats carry unusual changes in the sodium channels of their pain nerves, which researchers hope can inform pain medicine.
Which animal has the best immunity?
first_comment: Even at ten times the dose that made mice convulse, three of four bats were unfazed, and the fourth recovered in minutes. Which immune animal should we cover next?
